multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Postal Service has inbound revenues.
The Postal Service has many faults, leading to the decision to quit.
The Postal Service is believed to be detrimental to our economy.
The Postal Service does not submit any data to Congress.
The Postal Service is considered too important to our economy and intertwined with our everyday lives.
The Postal Service has outbound attributable costs.
Current outbound costs are exceeding Postal Service revenues.
The Postal Service yields results contrary to the entry price and net avoided cost measures for the cost of the USO.

The degree of preparation of mail for delivery into the postal system performed by the mailer affects reducing costs to the Postal Service as a factor to be considered in connection with a proposed change.
Employees may not approve their own T&A data in the Postal Service.
